description: Approve a merge request as the token's user (GitLab approval, Forgejo or GitHub approving review). Acts on the current project's merge requests on its SCM (GitLab, Forgejo or GitHub, found from the repository's git remotes).

merge_request_id.description: the merge request's number in this project, as the SCM shows it (GitLab !iid, Forgejo or GitHub pull request #number)

name: scm_approve_merge_request

scm.description: the SCM the call went to

project.description: the project's path on the SCM

approved.description: whether the approval rules are now met; null when the SCM does not say
